in_marathi.name: Athraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Athraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Athraj is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'Lord of Gods'. It is a revered name in Hindu mythology, signifying strength, power, and divine connection.
